items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Herbie Lewis happened to be on bass, just, this time along with me

ctx.x: Yeah, Joel Dorn. Yeah, he, he, he's, uh, he's deceased now. When he, uh, played that for me, you know, 'cause it was hard to get a sound, you know. The, the guy was sittin' by the tape machine at the, at the, uh, Left Bank, you know. He never even touched the machine, [laughs] you know, so sometime the bass was waaay up too loud, man, and he, he didn't, he didn't have on a headset, he wasn't that kinda … uh, what was his name? It escapes me. Uh, hm. Anyway, due to him, a lot of good music was lost 'cause this guy…
